Success is written only after merger success and the completed output marker. Original-controller termination before ready raises; termination after ready is accepted.

The current merger bytes match the existing PASS goal_report_source_review.json digest. Its existing checks retain full 245/220703 and 234/116649 coverage, all five metrics, 19+12 attributes, curves, paired 5000 seed-42 results and independent native CPU receipts. cases_passed: Wait until 07:30, poll at 180 seconds, then merge once after ready even when original PID has exited.
Merge once after ready while original PID is still alive.
Original PID stops before ready: fail without a merger call.
One required native CPU acceptance fails: fail without a merger call.
Merger returns failure: do not write a successful continuation receipt.
Existing continuation receipt: reject a duplicate launch before polling or merging.
local_control_flow_validation.method: Execute the unmodified wrapper in an in-memory environment with virtual files, clock, ps and merger responses. No metric scores were synthesized; only structural JSON fields were supplied.
